text: To extract a specific set of bits, you need a mask. For example, to get the last 5 bits, you need a mask with 5 ones: 0b11111 (which is 31).
Use the bitwise AND operator (`&`) with your mask to isolate the bits.
To extract bits that are not at the very end, use the right shift operator (`>>`) to move them to the rightmost position before masking.
